# ReactJS Proficiency Quiz Application

This is a React.js quiz application built with Vite, specifically designed to assess ReactJS proficiency. The application features:

- ReactJS-focused questions covering hooks, components, JSX, and best practices
- Proficiency-based scoring and skill level assessment
- Interactive UI with real-time feedback
- Modern, responsive design with beautiful styling
- Question navigation and detailed result analysis
- Timer functionality for skill assessment under pressure

## Development Guidelines

- Use functional components with React hooks
- Implement clean, modular component architecture
- Follow modern React best practices
- Use CSS modules or styled components for styling
- Ensure responsive design for mobile and desktop
- Implement proper state management for quiz flow
- Add smooth transitions and animations for better UX
- Focus on ReactJS educational content and accurate technical information
